name: Tribal Chief Supervises the Hospital
description: Dropping the Tribal Chief on the Hospital hotspot makes the chief supervise the hospital. A healer whose cure roll fails then gets a second chance: the chief's supervision roll, which passes about 25% of the time per Leadership level, lets the cure go ahead as if the healer had passed. Otherwise the cure is exactly the stock one. The stock game already gives the chief this supervision bonus for fishing, fruit, honey, huts, research and puzzles, but never for a cure. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** This patch needs no other row and does not add the Origins Upgrades buttons. It is on by default for The Secret City; untick it to keep the stock cure. The companion is "VVFP VV3 Chief Hospital.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock cure runs.
behavior_changes: When a healer's Healing roll in a cure fails (the roll at 0x457395), the game asks the chief's supervision roll 0x45FC60 for the Hospital site (9). That roll passes only when the Tribal Chief is alive, not sick, standing on the hospital hotspot (+0xEA0 = 9), and rand(100) < 25 x Leadership level; then the cure continues as a passed Healing roll does.
A passed Healing roll is unchanged, and so is every cure when no chief is on the hospital: the supervision roll then draws nothing from the game's random generator.
explicit_non_changes: This row changes no executable bytes: VVFP VV3 Chief Hospital.dll verifies the eight stock bytes at 0x45739A and writes a jump to its stub at run time; a different build of the game installs nothing.
The chief's supervision is unchanged everywhere else: fishing, fruit, honey, huts, research and puzzles keep their stock bonuses, and the chief still never picks a job.
A healer who dislikes medicine still fails half of their cures, as in the stock game; a chief's success is a pass of the Healing roll, not a guaranteed cure.
Catch-up healing (the cure scan at 0x45B94A) is not changed by this row.
Nothing is written to a villager record, the save or any file.

runtime_detours.routine: the healer's cure (0x457350): the test of the Healing roll's result, after its call at 0x457395; a failed roll asks the chief's supervision roll for the hospital (0x45FC60(9)) before the stock failure at 0x457431
